backup_playlists.name: Save the playlists as text files now
backup_playlists.description: Writes the playlists saved on the players as text files (.m3u8) in the bluos_companion/playlists folder of the Home Assistant configuration. This also happens before every Home Assistant backup, which then contains them.

restore_playlists.name: Restore playlists from the text files
restore_playlists.description: Rebuilds playlists saved by the backup on a player. The queue of that player is emptied and refilled for each playlist (the player can only save its queue as a playlist), so use a player that is not playing. A playlist that exists already is left alone unless you ask to replace it.

entity_id.name: Player
entity_id.description: The player to rebuild the playlists on.

playlists.name: Playlists
playlists.description: The names of the playlists to restore. All the files if empty.

replace.name: Replace existing playlists
replace.description: Replace a playlist that has the same name. Off by default.

check_covers.name: Check the album covers
check_covers.description: Reads the cover of every album of the music library and lists those that are heavier than the player accepts (600 KB): the player shows a placeholder for them. It takes a minute or two for a big library. The sensor Covers too large keeps the count of the last check.

entity_id.name: Player
entity_id.description: The player whose library is checked.

mute_group.name: Mute or unmute a group
mute_group.description: Mutes or unmutes all the players of the group a player belongs to, in one go (the standard mute service only affects the player it targets). Works with any member of the group. A player that is not grouped is muted alone.

mute.name: Mute
mute.description: On to mute, off to unmute.

play_preset.name: Play a preset
play_preset.description: Starts a preset of a player, given by its number (1, 2...) or by its name, which is understood without its case or accents, or from a word of it ("rouge" for Rouge FM). In a group, the music plays for the whole group.

entity_id.name: Player
entity_id.description: The player to start the preset on.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: The number or the name of the preset.

play_genre.name: Play a genre
play_genre.description: Plays a genre of the music library, given by its name, which is understood without its case or accents, or from a word of it. The genre is added to the queue and starts playing. In a group, the music plays for the whole group.

entity_id.name: Player
entity_id.description: The player to play the genre on.

genre.name: Genre
genre.description: The name of the genre, such as Dance.

shuffle.name: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Play the songs of the genre in random order.

clear_queue.name: Clear the queue
clear_queue.description: Empty the queue first, so that the genre replaces it instead of being added to it.

import_playlists.name: Import playlists exported from another music player
import_playlists.description: Converts the playlists (.m3u8 files) you exported from Apple Music or another music player and put in the bluos_companion/import folder of the Home Assistant configuration, so that the files are the ones of the music share as the player knows them, then builds them on the player. The queue of that player is emptied and refilled for each playlist, so use a player that is not playing. A playlist that exists already is left alone unless you ask to replace it.

entity_id.name: Player
entity_id.description: The player to build the playlists on, and to find the music share from.

restore.name: Build the playlists on the player
restore.description: Off to only convert the files, to look at them or to change them first, then use the restore action.

replace.name: Replace existing playlists
replace.description: Replace a playlist that has the same name. Off by default.

source_path.name: Folder of the music on the computer
source_path.description: The beginning of the paths of the exported files, for example /Users/me/Music/Music/Media.localized/Music/. Found by itself if empty.

library_path.name: Folder of the music on the player
library_path.description: Where the same folder is for the player, for example /var/mnt/nas-Share/Music/. Found by itself if empty.

backup_favourites.name: Save the favourites as a file now
backup_favourites.description: Writes the favourite albums, artists and songs of the library as a file (favourites.json) in the bluos_companion folder of the Home Assistant configuration. This also happens before every Home Assistant backup, which then contains it.

restore_favourites.name: Restore the favourites from the file
restore_favourites.description: Adds the favourites of the file that the player does not have yet. Nothing is removed. A song the library of the player does not know is not added, and the result lists it.

entity_id.name: Player
entity_id.description: The player to add the favourites to.
